items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 21 November 2026 5:30am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds developing.


##Wind)##

Variable 3 or less, becoming east or southeast 4 or 5 in the morning, then increasing 5 or 6 in the evening, then 6 or 7 around midnight.


##State of sea)##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight or moderate later this afternoon, then moderate or rough early tonight.


##Weather)##

Fair.


##Visibility)##

Good.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 6°C and max. air temperature 9°C
##Sea Temperature##

13°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds until later.


##Wind)##

East or southeast 6 or 7, deceasing 5 or 6 in the afternoon, then 4 or 5 around early in the night.


##State of sea)##

Mainly moderate, soon increasing moderate or rough for a time, then decreasing slight or moderate later.


##Weather)##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility)##

Good.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 7°C and max. air temperature 9°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C

##Warnings)##

Strong to gale force winds developing.


##Wind)##

Easterly 4 or 5, soon increasing southeast 5 or 6, further increasing 6 to gale 8 later.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate, becoming moderate or rough later.


##Weather)##

Fair, then a risk of rain arriving in the evening or early night.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain later.

12°C

Strong to gale force winds at first.

##State of sea)##

Moderate or rough, soon becoming slight or moderate, then slight later.


##Weather)##

Rain.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.

12°C
